name: Entradasuchus
sum: Entradasuchus is an early crocodyliform known from a single specimen from the Middle Jurassic Entrada Sandstone of Utah.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: The only known specimen, from the Entrada Ranch, Grand County, Utah.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Hunt and Lockley 1995

sources.text: Hunt, Adrian P.; Lockley, Martin G. 1995. A nonmarine tetrapod from the Middle Jurassic of the United States: a primitive crocodyliform from the Entrada Sandstone of eastern Utah. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 15(3): 554–560. doi:10.1080/02724634.1995.10011248
